label: The parameter tag in code documentation: lowercase 'param' written right after '@', ':' or a backslash ('@param', ':param', '\param') before an argument name, in Javadoc, JSDoc, PHPDoc, Doxygen or Sphinx comments, or when such a tag is mentioned in prose. Strongest inside a doc comment, weaker when the tag opens the text. Quiet: 'param' after a space in plain prose, 'Param', 'params', 'parameter', '_param', 'paramedic'. Other doc tags ('@return', '@throws', ':returns:') fire weakly, around a third of the peak.
